{{Quote|We lost a cruiser, the ''Redeemer''.|Anakin Skywalker|audio=WeLostTheRedeemer-SOR.flac|<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />}}
The '''''Redeemer''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] was seized by the Separatists, and a large Confederate [[Ryloth blockade/Legends|fleet]] under the command of [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the planet. The ''Redeemer'', along with the ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] and [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']], was part of a Republic task force led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], that was dispatched to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|eliminate]] the Confederate blockade.

Upon the arrival of Skywalker's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Ryloth system/Legends|Ryloth system]], Tuuk was able to lure the Republic forces into a trap. Tuuk summoned Confederate reinforcements, forcing Skywalker to order a retreat, but not before the ''Resolute'' and ''Defender'' had sustained damage. The ''Redeemer'', however, broke apart in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] under heavy fire.

==Description==
Manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]],<ref name="Databank" /> the ''Redeemer'' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> At 1,137 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, the ''Redeemer'' was armed with fifty-two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], eight [[DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turret/Legends|DBY-827 heavy dual turbolaser turrets]], two medium dual [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons, four [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launchers]], and six [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors.<ref name="Databank" /> The ''Redeemer'' was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and at least one [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. It also had eight [[Engine/Legends|engines]].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

==History==
===Attacking the blockade===
{{Quote|Our blockade is impenetrable. When the Republic attacks, they will get ''quite'' a surprise.|Captain Mar Tuuk, on his trap for Skywalker's task force|audio=OurBlockadeIsImpenetrable-SOR.flac|<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />}}
[[File:DefenderResoluteRedeemer-SOR.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Redeemer'' arrives in the Ryloth system alongside the ''Resolute'' and ''Defender''.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TCW date" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] was [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invaded]] by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] and [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] member [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], and its [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] populace was subjugated to a harsh rule. Tambor also [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the planet and placed the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]] in charge of the Confederate [[Ryloth blockade/Legends|fleet]]. In response, the Republic dispatched [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to breach the Confederate blockade and make way for Republic invasion forces&mdash;under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]&mdash;to land and liberate the planet. The ''Redeemer'', along with the ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']] and [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], was assigned to Skywalker's task force, while [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] accompanied Skywalker aboard the ''Resolute''.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

When the ''Redeemer'' and the rest of Skywalker's task force arrived out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the [[Ryloth system/Legends|Ryloth system]], the Republic battle group immediately engaged the Confederate blockade. Tano led [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]]&mdash;a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]&mdash;on an attack run on [[Procurer|Tuuk's ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] and the two [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] flanking it. The ''Redeemer'' and the other two ''Venator''-class [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] remained behind and provided heavy support fire. Blue Squadron managed to cut a path through the Confederate [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] to Tuuk's [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]]; however, Tuuk summoned four more ''Munificent''-class [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] to support his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. The Confederate reinforcements opened fire upon the Republic task force, causing heavy damage to all three Star Destroyers.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

===''Redeemer''{{'s}} destruction===
{{Quote|Your forces have been cut in half, Skywalker. If you can't break that blockade before the next planetary rotation, we will have to postpone the invasion.|Mace Windu, on Skywalker's depleted forces|audio=PostponeTheInvasion-SoR.flac|<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />}}
[[File:RedeemerDestruction-StormOverRyloth.png|thumb|right|200px|The ''Redeemer'' is destroyed.]]
With the Republic fleet outnumbered, Yularen ordered a full retreat from the [[Star system/Legends|system]], and called Tano and her squadron back to the ''Resolute'' to give fighter cover. However, Tano disobeyed orders, believing that she could reach Tuuk's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] and break the blockade. Without Tano's assistance, the ''Redeemer'' and the other two Star Destroyers sustained heavy damage from Vulture droid [[Death/Legends|suicide]] attacks. After losing most of Blue Squadron, Tano returned to the Republic fleet, and the ''Defender'' and the ''Resolute'' were able to retreat to hyperspace. However, the ''Redeemer'' had taken too much damage and broke apart in [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" />

Skywalker was eventually able to break the Confederate blockade during his second assault.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> The destruction of the blockade allowed Kenobi and Windu's ground forces to land<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref> and recapture Ryloth.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Redeemer'' first appeared in "[[Jedi Crash]],"<ref name="Jedi Crash">{{TCW|Jedi Crash}}</ref> the thirteenth episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], which aired on [[January 16]], [[2009]],<ref name="Jedi Crash Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode013.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Jedi Crash}}</ref> albeit in the episode's opening newsreel.<ref name="Jedi Crash" /> The ship later made its full appearance and was identified as the ''Redeemer'' in the first season's nineteenth episode, "[[Storm Over Ryloth]],"<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth" /> which aired on [[February 27]] of that same year.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode019.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref>
